notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism three times by removing three charge counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pentad Prism
uses.cardState: with a charge counter on it
